_comment_passkeys: Chromium draws its own passkey/WebAuthn autofill row ("Use passkey from another device", the cross-device hybrid transport) as NATIVE browser UI anchored to the username field. It is not page content, so the viewer cannot restyle or reach it, and on a phone-sized viewport it covers the form. PasswordManagerEnabled=false does not suppress it; this policy is the one that governs passkeys. Verified against this build's policy keys (policy::key::kPasswordManagerPasskeysEnabled).
